description: A pair of analogue-style oscillators with a sub-oscillator, hard sync, through-zero linear FM and a ring modulator, all mixed to one output, and every control with its own CV jack

params.text: Blends oscillator 1 from triangle at fully counter-clockwise through sawtooth in the middle to pulse at fully clockwise
Moves the phase of oscillator 1's triangle and the width of its pulse, from 0% through 50% at the centre to 100%
Sets the level of oscillator 1 in the mix, 0 to 1
Sets the level of the sub-oscillator in the mix, 0 to 1; it is a square one octave below oscillator 1
Blends oscillator 2 from triangle at fully counter-clockwise through sawtooth in the middle to pulse at fully clockwise
Moves the phase of oscillator 2's triangle and the width of its pulse, from 0% through 50% at the centre to 100%
Sets the level of oscillator 2 in the mix, 0 to 1
Turns hard sync on, which restarts oscillator 2 every time oscillator 1 completes a cycle
Sets how much oscillator 1 modulates oscillator 2's frequency, 0 to 1; the modulation goes through zero and leaves oscillator 2's pitch where it was
Sets the level of the ring modulator in the mix, 0 to 1; it is oscillator 1 multiplied by oscillator 2

inputs.text: Added to its shape knob at a fifth of the knob's travel per volt
Added to its pulse width knob at a fifth of the knob's travel per volt
Added to its volume knob at a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Added to the Sub knob at a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Divided by 5 and added to the Sync switch, so anything above 5V turns sync on
Added to the FM knob at a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Added to the RM knob at a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
The pitch of oscillator 1, one volt per octave; its channel count and that of the other pitch jack together set the polyphony of the module
The pitch of oscillator 2, one volt per octave; its channel count and that of the other pitch jack together set the polyphony of the module

outputs.text: Oscillator 1, the sub-oscillator, oscillator 2 and the ring modulator added together at their set levels

notes: there is no volume control for the module as a whole; the four level knobs are what set the output level
the two shape controls and the two pulse width controls both take their CV at a fifth of the knob's travel per volt, while the four level controls take theirs at a tenth
menu: Oversampling rate: 1x to 1024x — runs the oscillators above the sample rate to cut aliasing; the waveforms are generated plainly, so heavy oversampling is what keeps sync and FM clean
Anti-aliasing — adds polyBLEP and polyBLAMP corrections to the corners of the waveforms, which costs little and helps a great deal
DC blocker — takes out the offset that FM and the ring modulator can put on the output; on to begin with
Saturator — holds the output to about -10V and 10V
LFO mode — drops both oscillators to 2Hz at 0V and switches the oversampling and the DC blocker off inside
